pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: src/features/scraper/useScraperData.ts:95 The wizard saves scraper configurations as entity rows through the scraper API, not through the app settings key-value store. A case-insensitive grep of src/features/scraper (including __tests__) for 'setting', 'preference', 'localStorage' and 'settingKeys' found zero hits, so no technique of the settings subject has a precondition here.

pairs.subject: settings
pairs.evidence: src/api/__tests__/settings.test.ts:25 The bridge test mocks an unregistered key returning null. The real store does the opposite: get_app_setting calls require_valid_key, and validate_key returns Err("unknown settings key") (src-tauri/db/src/settings_keys.rs:1701). So the suite pins and documents the free-string, typo-reads-as-default contract that the store-side allowlist was built to remove.

techniques.evidence: src/api/__tests__/settings.test.ts:25 Asserts that an unknown key reads as null. The backend rejects it with 'unknown settings key'. 'theme' (lines 15/30/36) is also not on ALLOWED_KEYS, and no test pins the rejection of an unregistered write.
